The film's opening keeps moving. The picture sets the pace now: the born hold inside the morph shrinks from 10 s to 1.5 s, the morph leaves the opening and plays after the rail beat as the change of mind, and every cue-free pause after a window beat drops to one second; the living close keeps a named two-second hold. The committed tear-out opens the film. Budgets are re-cut to the removed holds and re-pinned at 93 s inside the 90–150 s envelope; every scene and cue id is unchanged, so the dialogue's bindings move with their scenes. The film witness's `[film-probe] auto beat` line now carries the elapsed milliseconds since the previous beat and since the tour started, so one replay log is the silent rehearsal receipt — posted on #15252 for #19126's AC-4. Data and one log line; no executor change.

Was stacked on PR #19128 (the `rail` cue and `film-rails` scene this order relies on); with #19128 merged, `dev` is merged into this branch (`47c1b8b7cb`, three comment/screenplay hunks resolved to this leaf's side) and the diff against `dev` is exactly the three files below.
